sections.content_markdown:
By the end of the chapter we will be able to -

* explain mineral resources
* compare among rocks, minerals and ores
* find out the appropriate ways of metal extraction
* explain the cause of making alloys
* describe source of sulfur and reactions of formation of some of its important compounds, their chemical properties and analyze their uses in houses, industries and agriculture
* analyze the importance of limitation, appropriate use and recycling of minerals
* show sincerity in use of minerals and keenness in preserving
